searchApiPlaceholder: Search by URL, name or prefix…
title: Groups
description: Groups connect available models, resources and user entitlements.
name: Name
sharedCapacity: A VM shares concurrency capacity across groups
rpmHelp: The per-minute request limit for each user in this group, shared across their API keys. 0 removes the group RPM limit; the user's global RPM limit still applies.
imageBillingHelp: Configure image generation and base image prices. Leave blank to use the defaults.
allow_image_generation: Allow image generation in this group
imageRateHelp: Without an independent rate, image cost = image price × the group's effective rate; with it, image cost = image price × the image rate. Per-image billing applies to the Images endpoints; the image tool inside a conversation is still billed by tokens.
webSearchPriceHelp: Leave blank for the default $0.01 per search (official $10 per 1,000); 0 makes it free. The group rate multiplier is applied on top.
webSearchPricePreview: Price per search after the current rate: {{price}}
resourcePlaceholder: Search by resource name or ID…
priorityHelp: A VM can belong to multiple groups and share its capacity. Lower group priority numbers run first; VMs are first grouped by their existing scheduling tier.
noVms: No VMs yet. Create a slot first.
deleteHelp: Groups referenced by keys or subscriptions cannot be deleted. Usage and billing history are retained.
copyHelp: User permissions, subscriptions and funds are not copied. Supplier Codex accounts are copied with resources only when the new group is within their authorized scope.
selectModels: Select models (leave empty for no extra restriction)
modelPlaceholder: Search by model name or ID…
catalogError: Failed to load the model catalog. Please try again later.
whitelistHelp: Models come from the Models page, filtered by platform. Checked models form the allowlist and appear first. Leave empty to allow every model supported by the group's resources.
unlimitedGroupRpm: 0 = unlimited group RPM; the user's total RPM limit still applies.
overrideHelp: Removing an override restores the group default. Overrides do not change group access permissions.
apiResourceHelp: API endpoint groups cannot mix with VM slots. Selected resources are kept at the top.
backendMixWarning: The account pool (VM slots, Codex accounts) and API endpoints cannot share a group. Clear one of them before saving.
codexFastModeHint: Applied by the Gateway Worker from the account's plan catalog: enabled turns unset/default tiers into priority when supported; disabled turns priority/fast back into default. Billed at the tier actually sent.
noCodexAccounts: No Codex accounts yet. Authorize one on the Codex accounts page first.
codexAccountHelp: Codex accounts and VM slots form the account pool and can share a group. When a group has Codex accounts, GPT requests go to the Gateway Worker first; Codex VMs only take requests the Worker did not send. Supplier accounts can only join groups the supplier is authorized for.
codexAccountCount: Includes {{count}} Codex accounts (served by the Gateway Worker, not counted in capacity)
codexAccountCount_one: Includes {{count}} Codex account (served by the Gateway Worker, not counted in capacity)
codexAccountCount_other: Includes {{count}} Codex accounts (served by the Gateway Worker, not counted in capacity)
